purpose: Spend verification time first on LIVE and promotion-ready jobs whose decision-critical evidence is most likely to have changed.
priorityOrder: LIVE job with stale apply-path or active-state evidence
remote-ok job with remote-policy evidence nearing expiry
high-score job with stale compensation or hard-requirement evidence

budget.note: Revalidation must not starve non-Profesia discovery. Unused revalidation budget returns to discovery.

expectedBenefit: Reduces wasted canonical checks while catching expiring, closed, or materially changed high-value jobs before application time is lost.
